scope.text: Grid rules in packages/contracts/src/grid.ts: 24 columns, rows 4..100 (default 12), hard 24x100 bound, occupiedRows/gridRows, and move/resize/findFreeRect limited by max(rows, current bottom) so red-zone widgets can only move out.
Per-screen rows: ScreenBoard.rows in contracts, screens.rows column via migration 3 with CHECK 4..100, read and saved by apps/api/src/rooms.ts.

Fluid board UI: html font-size 100vw/80, board as an inline-size container with stable scrollbar gutter and square --ld-cell, rendered rows held during pointer operations, green/red dots, exposed setRows, active-rect dragging state and ResizeObserver.
Base design section 7.4 updated to the 24-column fluid grid in commit 26cb754.

items.change: Migration 3 bumps the revision only of rooms that had widgets, not every room as the spec states.
items.reason: Stated in the plan: bumping every room would also bump the fresh seed room and break API fixtures, while an empty room has no layout to overwrite and a pre-migration tab sends screens without rows, which the API rejects with 400.
items.effect: Pre-migration tabs of rooms with widgets get 409 and reload; empty rooms keep their revision.

excludedScope.text: Out of scope per the spec: auto-scroll while dragging near the board edge, configurable column count, larger sizeClass thresholds, server-side enforcement of the red-zone rule, mobile layout.

risks.text: No implementation-review report, test log or manual browser report was found for this feature; the spec's manual browser checks are unrecorded.

decisions.text: Cell size is pure CSS: the board is an inline-size container and --ld-cell = (100cqw - 23 gaps) / 24, so no measuring code is needed and it follows the board scrollbar. scrollbar-gutter: stable avoids layout jumps; a classic scrollbar costs under 1% of proportionality.

Red-zone rule is one formula, limit = max(rows, current bottom) of the rect before the step: a red widget can move up, sideways, shrink or widen but never lower its bottom edge. Lowering rows never moves or hides widgets; the grid renders down to the lowest widget. The server checks only the hard 24x100 bound because it does not know where a widget stood before the session.
Rows are stored per screen and saved with the layout under expectedRevision in one PUT; the rows field lives in the edit-mode working copy so Cancel reverts it.

Migration 3 deletes all placed widgets and widget state because 12-column coordinates are not carried over (requested by the user); it is irreversible for those rows, while packages, versions, grants and widget_audit stay.

Scale is html font-size calc(100vw / 80) without a cap (16 px at 1280), so text, gaps and cells scale together; sandbox frames already take rootFontSize from the host. sizeClass thresholds stay unchanged in cells.
